newsitem.title: KYRGYZSTAN: BUS CRASH KILLS 10 MEMBERS OF KYRGYZ SOCCER CLUB.
newsitem.headline: BUS CRASH KILLS 10 MEMBERS OF KYRGYZ SOCCER CLUB.

text.p: Ten members of an amateur soccer club in Kyrgyzstan were killed and 12 were seriously hurt in a weekend bus crash, a Kyrgyz official said on Monday.
"Ten people were killed in the accident," Kanat Urmanbetov, a spokesman for the remote Central Asian state's emergencies ministry, said following the crash late on Saturday.

Urmanbetov said the driver of the bus, which was carrying the Tepe-Kurgansky soccer club from southern Kyrgyzstan, lost control of the vehicle and it overturned on a mountainous road near the southern border with Tajikistan.
He said some of those hurt had been taken to hospital in the southern village of Gulcha with serious head injuries.
